sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Flame sensed out of sequence, and the flame is still present.
causes: Flame present when it should not be
diySteps: If you smell gas, leave the building and call the gas supplier from outside. Do not turn the furnace back on
Technician: shut off the gas, check for a gas valve leak, and replace the valve if necessary. The alert clears when the fault is recovered
proAdvice: E241 means flame was sensed out of sequence and is still present. E275 is the out-of-sequence soft lockout after the flame signal is gone. This is gas-valve work. Call a licensed HVAC technician, or the gas supplier if you smell gas.
